rules.name: Forbid whispering
rules.description: The player cannot send whispers to other people in the room.

settings.name: allowLover
settings.label: Still allow whispering to Lover-ranked roles and above

rules.name: Forbid OOC messages
rules.description: The player cannot send messages containing out-of-character (parenthesized) text. Whispers are not affected.

rules.name: Block OOC while gagged
rules.description: The player cannot use out-of-character (parenthesized) text while gagged - a gag should not be so easy to talk around.

rules.name: Forbidden words
rules.description: The player cannot use the configured words in chat or whispers.

settings.name: includeOOC
settings.label: Also forbid the words in OOC (parentheses)

rules.name: Mandatory words
rules.description: Every chat message must contain at least one of the configured words (e.g. "Miss, please, humbly"). Purely out-of-character messages are exempt.

rules.name: Require detailed speech
rules.description: Every chat message must contain at least the configured number of words - doll talk in reverse, for detailed roleplay. Purely out-of-character messages and emotes are exempt.

rules.name: Restrained speech
rules.description: The player can only say the configured phrases, nothing else (case and end punctuation are ignored). Purely out-of-character messages are exempt.

rules.name: Doll talk
rules.description: The player can only speak in short, simple phrases: limited words per message and letters per word. Out-of-character text is not affected.

rules.name: Replace spoken words
rules.description: Configured words are replaced in everything the player says. Each entry is word:replacement (e.g. "i:this doll"). Out-of-character text is not affected.

rules.name: Enforce faltering speech
rules.description: The player's spoken messages come out st-st-stuttering. Out-of-character text is not affected.

rules.name: Forbid shouting
rules.description: All-caps chat messages are lowered to normal speech when enforced.

rules.name: Forbid emotes
rules.description: The player cannot send emote messages to the room.

rules.name: Forbid beep messages
rules.description: The player cannot send beeps with message content to friends.

settings.name: allowPlainBeeps
settings.label: Still allow plain beeps without a message

rules.name: Forbid sending beeps
rules.description: The player cannot send any beeps at all, with or without a message. Hidden mod-to-mod beeps (leashes, summons, BCX) are unaffected, and configured members can still be beeped.

settings.name: allowedMembers
settings.label: Members who may still be beeped:

rules.name: Forbid friend-list changes
rules.description: The player cannot add or remove BC friends; each direction can be toggled separately. Covers the friend list screen and in-room dialogs.

rules.name: Forbid leaving the room
rules.description: The player cannot leave the chat room they are in - the exit button and leave commands from other mods are both blocked. Forced moves (leashes, kicks, BC's safeword release) and disconnects are not prevented.

rules.name: Forbid creating new rooms
rules.description: The player cannot open the room creation screen. Changing settings of an existing room they administrate is unaffected.

rules.name: Restrict entering rooms
rules.description: The player can only join rooms whose name is on the configured list (case-insensitive). As a safety measure the rule does nothing while the list is empty. Being moved by a BC+ command or summon is not restricted. Combines well with "Forbid creating new rooms".

rules.name: Forbid room admin UI while blind
rules.description: The player cannot open the room administration screen while unable to see - it would disclose the room background and admin member numbers. Admin chat commands still work.

rules.name: Order to greet the room
rules.description: On entering a chat room, the player automatically says the configured greeting.

rules.name: Farewell on leave
rules.description: When leaving a chat room, the player automatically says the configured farewell first.

rules.name: Listen to my voice
rules.description: One of the configured sentences appears to the player at random, at the set interval, while they are in a chat room. Only they can see it.

rules.name: Ready to be summoned
rules.description: Configured members can summon the player from anywhere in the club with a beep whose message starts with the summon text (or just "summon"). After the delay, the player is pulled to the summoner's room - ignoring leashes and locked doors. If the target room is full, they end up in the lobby. The summoner must be in a room and leave "attach room" enabled when writing the beep, or it carries no room to move to.

rules.name: Forbid club owner changes
rules.description: The player cannot leave their current club owner or submit to a new one. Advancing a trial to full ownership is unaffected, and their owner can still release them.

rules.name: Forbid getting new lovers
rules.description: The player cannot start dating anyone new. Advancing an existing lovership (dating to engagement to marriage) is unaffected.

rules.name: Forbid breaking up with lovers
rules.description: The player cannot leave any of their lovers, at any lovership stage - neither through the Management mistress nor directly in a chat room. Their lovers can still break up with them.

rules.name: Forbid taking new submissives
rules.description: The player cannot offer an ownership trial to a new submissive. Advancing an existing trial to full ownership is unaffected.

rules.name: Forbid disowning submissives
rules.description: The player cannot let go of any of their submissives (trial or full ownership). Their submissives can still break the bond themselves.

rules.name: Prevent blacklisting
rules.description: The player cannot add people holding the configured role (or higher) to their BC blacklist or ghostlist.

rules.name: Prevent whitelisting
rules.description: The player can only add people holding the configured role (or higher) to their BC whitelist.

settings.name: minRole
settings.label: Lowest role allowed on the whitelist

rules.name: Hardcore Mode
rules.description: Forces both hardcore options from the General page on while this rule is in effect, locked: the player cannot open their own BC+ while their hands are bound, and people whose hands are bound are refused when they try to change anything in the player's BC+. The player's own choice of the two options is untouched underneath and returns the moment the rule ends. Requires enforcement to have any effect.

rules.name: Forbid tying up self
rules.description: The player cannot use items on their own body, including swapping worn items.

rules.name: Forbid tying up others
rules.description: The player cannot use items on other characters. Can be limited to characters with a higher dominant score than the player.

settings.name: onlyDominants
settings.label: Only forbid using items on more dominant characters

rules.name: Forbid freeing self
rules.description: The player cannot remove, struggle out of or escape items on their own body. Others can still remove them. Low-difficulty items (hand-held toys, plushies...) can optionally stay removable.

rules.name: Forbid freeing others
rules.description: The player cannot remove items from other characters. Low-difficulty items (hand-held toys, plushies...) can optionally stay removable.

rules.name: Forbid wardrobe use on self
rules.description: The player cannot change their own clothes. Others can still change them.

rules.name: Forbid wardrobe use on others
rules.description: The player cannot change the clothes of other club members.

rules.name: Forbid using remotes on self
rules.description: The player cannot use a vibrator remote on their own body. Others can still use remotes on them.

rules.name: Forbid using remotes on others
rules.description: The player cannot use a vibrator remote on anyone else.

rules.name: Forbid using keys on self
rules.description: The player cannot unlock locks on their own body, even with the key.

rules.name: Forbid using keys on others
rules.description: The player cannot unlock locks on anyone else.

rules.name: Forbid picking locks on self
rules.description: The player cannot pick locks on their own body.

rules.name: Forbid picking locks on others
rules.description: The player cannot pick locks on anyone else.

rules.name: Forbid using locks on self
rules.description: The player cannot apply locks to their own body.

rules.name: Forbid using locks on others
rules.description: The player cannot apply locks to anyone else.

rules.name: Sensory deprivation: Sound
rules.description: Impacts the player's natural hearing the same way items do, independent of them. Strength is adjustable; stacks with worn items.

rules.name: Hearing whitelist
rules.description: The listed members are always understood clearly, no matter how deafened the player is (by items or rules). Optionally even when those members are gagged.

settings.name: includeGagged
settings.label: Understand them even while they are gagged

rules.name: Sensory deprivation: Sight
rules.description: Impacts the player's natural eyesight the same way items do, independent of them. Strength is adjustable; stacks with worn items.

rules.name: Seeing whitelist
rules.description: The listed members are always seen normally, no matter how blinded the player is (by items or rules).

rules.name: Forbid changing poses
rules.description: The player cannot change their own body pose unaided - kneeling, standing up, spreading and every other pose stays as it is. Others (and items) can still pose them.

rules.name: Forbid specific poses
rules.description: The player cannot change into the listed poses by themselves. Pose names: BaseUpper, BackBoxTie, BackCuffs, BackElbowTouch, OverTheHead, Yoked, BaseLower, Kneel, KneelingSpread, LegsClosed, Spread, Hogtied, AllFours, Suspension, TapedHands.

rules.name: Forced to kneel
rules.description: The player must stay on their knees: choosing a standing lower-body pose is blocked, and if they end up standing they are put back down. Poses that need aid (restraints forcing them upright) are left alone rather than fought.

rules.name: Forced position
rules.description: The player is held in a chosen position: pick an arms pose, a legs pose, or both (e.g. hands behind back with legs spread), or a full-body position (hogtied or all fours) that overrides the other two. Changing away is blocked and any deviation is corrected. Poses held by restraints are left alone rather than fought.

rules.name: Forced AFK behavior
rules.description: When the player goes idle, the configured behaviors apply automatically: the Afk emoticon, closed eyes, kneeling, and an automatic reply to whispers. Emoticon and eyes are restored the moment the player is back; a forced kneel is left for them to stand up from.

settings.name: replyText
settings.label: Auto-reply text:
settings.default: I am away from the club right now.

rules.name: Speak like a pet
rules.description: The player's speech turns pet-like: Sprinkle mode weaves animal sounds between the words, Replace mode swaps words for sounds outright - up to fully non-verbal at Max intensity. Pick an animal sound set or provide custom sounds. Out-of-character text is never touched.

settings.name: sounds
settings.label: Custom sounds (used with the Custom set):

rules.name: Hear like a pet
rules.description: Pet words - commands, praise, the pet's own name, the chosen animal's vocabulary and any custom extras - always come through clearly, while the rest of what the player hears garbles away. "Only when deafened" merely lets the pet words pierce existing deafness (item- or hunger-induced); Light and Heavy garble everything else all the time. Out-of-character text is never touched.

rules.name: Control orgasms
rules.description: Controls what happens when the player's arousal peaks, independent of items: Edge keeps the meter just below the top so the orgasm never starts; Ruin starts the orgasm screen but denies the actual climax; No resisting removes the option to fight an orgasm off. Requires the arousal meter to be enabled.

rules.name: Secret arousal meter
rules.description: The player cannot see their own arousal meter even while it is active - the orgasm quick-time event comes as a surprise. Whether others can see the meter is unchanged (that stays a BC setting).

rules.name: Forbid changing difficulty
rules.description: The player cannot change their Bondage Club multiplayer difficulty, whatever it currently is.

rules.name: Forbid using activities
rules.description: The player cannot use any (sexual) activities on anyone - the activities button vanishes from the item dialogs. Others can still use activities on the player; the arousal system itself stays untouched.

rules.name: Forbid changing emoticon
rules.description: The player cannot show, change or remove the emoticon (afk, sleep, ...) over their own head.

rules.name: Restrict who may leash
rules.description: Only people of at least the configured BC+ role can take the player onto a leash; everyone else's leash slips off with a room message.

rules.name: Control nickname
rules.description: Locks the player's BC nickname: with a nickname configured it is forced to that; with the field left empty the nickname the player had when the rule took hold is kept. The nickname stays as-is when the rule ends.

rules.name: Lock profile description
rules.description: Freezes the player's online profile description: any change is reverted to the text it had when the rule took hold. The description stays as-is when the rule ends.
